subject: math
title: Integral Calculus
syllabus: Integral as an anti-derivative, fundamental integrals, integration by substitution, by parts and by partial fractions, integration using trigonometric identities. Evaluation of simple integrals. Fundamental theorem of calculus, properties of definite integrals, evaluation of definite integrals, determining areas of the regions bounded by simple curves in standard form.

body: ∫f(x)dx = F(x) + C means F'(x) = f(x). Always check by differentiating your answer.
∫x^{n} = \f{x^{n+1}}{n + 1} · ∫\f{1}{x} = log|x| · ∫e^{x} = e^{x} · ∫sin x = −cos x · ∫cos x = sin x
Substitution: spot a function and its derivative together. Parts: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du.
Partial fractions split \f{px + q}{(x − a)(x − b)} into \f{A}{x − a} + \f{B}{x − b}.
∫_{a}^{b}f(x)dx = F(b) − F(a): the signed area under the curve.
Odd f on [−a, a] → 0. Even f → 2∫_{0}^{a}.
Pairing f(x) with f(a + b − x) often turns a hard integrand into 1: then I = \f{b − a}{2}.
Wallis: ∫_{0}^{π/2}sin^{n}x dx = \f{n − 1}{n}·\f{n − 3}{n − 2}… (× \f{π}{2} if n is even).
a sin x + b cos x on top of c sin x + d cos x: write top = λ(bottom) + μ(bottom)'.
Rational in tan x: divide by cos^{k}x and put t = tan x.
[g(x)] is constant between the points where g(x) crosses an integer: split the integral there.
Find where the curves meet; area = ∫(top − bottom)dx between those points.
If the region is easier sideways, slice horizontally: ∫(right − left)dy.
Parabola y = ax^{2} and a line cutting it at r_{1}, r_{2}: area = \f{|a|(r_{2} − r_{1})^{3}}{6}.
Use symmetry: |x|, even functions, ellipses and circles.

check.q: Area between y = x^{2} and y = 1:

traps: Area is never negative: split where the curve crosses the axis.
Do not forget + C in indefinite integrals.
Change the limits when you substitute.
Find the meeting points before integrating "top − bottom".
[x] changes value at every integer inside the limits.
log|x|, not log x, when x can be negative.

pyq.q: If the area of the region {(x, y) : |4 − x^{2}| ≤ y ≤ x^{2}, y ≤ 4, x ≥ 0} is (\f{80√{2}}{α} − β), α, β ∈ N, then α + β is equal to ____.
sol: The region lies between x = √{2} (where 4 − x^{2} = x^{2}) and x = 2√{2} (where x^{2} − 4 = 4).

pyq.q: The area of the region bounded by the curve y = max{|x|, x|x − 2|}, the x-axis and the lines x = −2 and x = 4 is equal to ____.
sol: On [−2, 0] the max is |x|; on [0, 1] it is x(2 − x); on [1, 3] it is x; on [3, 4] it is x(x − 2).

pyq.q: The area of the region {(x, y) : |x − y| ≤ y ≤ 4√{x}} is
sol: |x − y| ≤ y means y ≥ \f{x}{2}. The curves y = \f{x}{2} and y = 4√{x} meet at x = 64.

pyq.q: If the area of the region {(x, y) : |x − 5| ≤ y ≤ 4√{x}} is A, then 3A is equal to ____.
sol: y = 4√{x} meets y = 5 − x at x = 1 and y = x − 5 at x = 25.

pyq.q: The area (in sq. units) of the region described by {(x, y) : y^{2} ≤ 2x, and y ≥ 4x − 1} is
sol: Slice horizontally: \f{y^{2}}{2} ≤ x ≤ \f{y + 1}{4}; they meet at y = −\f{1}{2} and y = 1.

pyq.q: The area enclosed between the curves y = x|x| and y = x − |x| is :
sol: For x ≥ 0 the curves are y = x^{2} and y = 0, which only touch at 0; for x < 0 they are y = −x^{2} and y = 2x, meeting at x = −2.

pyq.q: Let the area of the region enclosed by the curves y = 3x, 2y = 27 − 3x and y = 3x − x√{x} be A. Then 10A is equal to ____.
sol: y = 3x and 2y = 27 − 3x meet at x = 3; the line meets y = 3x − x√{x} at x = 9.

pyq.q: If the area of the region bounded by the curves y = 4 − \f{x^{2}}{4} and y = \f{x − 4}{2} is equal to α, then 6α equals
sol: They meet where x^{2} + 2x − 24 = 0: x = −6 and 4.

pyq.q: If the area of the region {(x, y) : 1 + x^{2} ≤ y ≤ min{x + 7, 11 − 3x}} is A, then 3A is equal to
sol: The lines meet at x = 1; the parabola meets y = x + 7 at x = −2 and y = 11 − 3x at x = 2.

pyq.q: The area of the region in the first quadrant inside the circle x^{2} + y^{2} = 8 and outside the parabola y^{2} = 2x is equal to :
sol: Outside the parabola means x < \f{y^{2}}{2}. Slice horizontally: 0 ≤ x ≤ min{\f{y^{2}}{2}, √{8 − y^{2}}}; the curves meet at (2, 2).

pyq.q: Let the area of the region enclosed by the curve y = min{sin x, cos x} and the x-axis between x = −π to x = π be A. Then A^{2} is equal to ____.
sol: Track which is smaller: sin x on (−\f{3π}{4}, \f{π}{4}), cos x elsewhere.
Adding the pieces of |min{sin x, cos x}| gives A = 4 → A^{2} = 16.

pyq.q: The area (in square units) of the region enclosed by the ellipse x^{2} + 3y^{2} = 18 in the first quadrant below the line y = x is :
sol: The line meets the ellipse at (\f{3}{√{2}}, \f{3}{√{2}}); below the line the region is bounded by y = x then by the ellipse.
In the stretched picture (y → √{3}y) this is a circular sector: area = √{3}π.

pyq.q: If the area of the region bounded by 16x^{2} − 9y^{2} = 144 and 8x − 3y = 24 is A, then 3(A + 6 log_{e}(3)) is equal to ____.
sol: The line passes through the vertex (3, 0) and meets the right branch again at (5, \f{16}{3}); slicing horizontally, x runs from the hyperbola x = 3√{1 + \f{y^{2}}{16}} to the line x = 3 + \f{3y}{8}.

pyq.q: If the area of the region {(x, y) : 1 − 2x ≤ y ≤ 4 − x^{2}, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0} is \f{α}{β}, α, β ∈ N, gcd(α, β) = 1, then the value of (α + β) is :
sol: For 0 ≤ x ≤ \f{1}{2} the bottom is 1 − 2x, then y = 0; the top is 4 − x^{2} up to x = 2.

pyq.q: The area of the region {(x, y) : x^{2} + 4x + 2 ≤ y ≤ |x + 2|} is equal to
sol: Shift t = x + 2: t^{2} − 2 ≤ y ≤ |t|, symmetric about t = 0, meeting at |t| = 2.

pyq.q: The area (in sq. units) of the region {(x, y) : 0 ≤ y ≤ 2|x| + 1, 0 ≤ y ≤ x^{2} + 1, |x| ≤ 3} is
sol: The upper edge is the smaller of 2|x| + 1 and x^{2} + 1: the parabola for |x| ≤ 2, the line beyond.

pyq.q: The area of the region bounded by the curves x(1 + y^{2}) = 1 and y^{2} = 2x is:
sol: Slice horizontally: \f{y^{2}}{2} ≤ x ≤ \f{1}{1 + y^{2}}; they meet at y = ±1.

pyq.q: Let the area of the region {(x, y) : 2y ≤ x^{2} + 3, y + |x| ≤ 3, y ≥ |x − 1|} be A. Then 6A is equal to :
sol: Upper edge: the smaller of \f{x^{2} + 3}{2} and 3 − |x|; lower edge |x − 1|.
Add the pieces between the crossing points: A = \f{7}{3} → 6A = 14.

pyq.q: Let the area enclosed between the curves |y| = 1 − x^{2} and x^{2} + y^{2} = 1 be α. If 9α = βπ + γ; β, γ are integers, then the value of |β − γ| equals.
sol: The curve |y| = 1 − x^{2} sits inside the unit circle; between them the area is π − 2∫_{−1}^{1}(1 − x^{2})dx = π − \f{8}{3}.

pyq.q: The area of the region {(x, y) : y ≤ π − |x|, y ≤ |x sin x|, y ≥ 0} is:
sol: y = |x sin x| meets y = π − |x| at |x| = \f{π}{2}. Use symmetry: twice the area for x ≥ 0.

pyq.q: The area of the region A = {(x, y) : 4x^{2} + y^{2} ≤ 8 and y^{2} ≤ 4x} is:
sol: Slice horizontally: \f{y^{2}}{4} ≤ x ≤ \f{√{8 − y^{2}}}{2}; the curves meet at y = ±2.

pyq.q: The area of the region R = {(x, y) : xy ≤ 27, 1 ≤ y ≤ x^{2}} is equal to:
sol: Slice horizontally: √{y} ≤ x ≤ \f{27}{y} (x > 0 since xy ≤ 27 with x ≥ √{y}); they meet at y = 9.

pyq.q: The area of the region enclosed between the circles x^{2} + y^{2} = 4 and x^{2} + (y − 2)^{2} = 4 is :
sol: The circles meet at y = 1, x = ±√{3}: the lens is two equal circular segments.

pyq.q: The area of the region {(x, y) : 0 ≤ y ≤ 6 − x, y^{2} ≥ 4x − 3, x ≥ 0} is:
sol: Slice horizontally: 0 ≤ x ≤ min{6 − y, \f{y^{2} + 3}{4}}; the two meet at y = 3.

pyq.q: The area of the region {(x, y) : x^{2} − 8x ≤ y ≤ −x} is:
sol: They meet where x^{2} − 7x = 0: x = 0 and 7.

pyq.q: The area of the region R = {(x, y) : xy ≤ 8, 1 ≤ y ≤ x^{2}, x ≥ 0} is
sol: Slice horizontally: √{y} ≤ x ≤ \f{8}{y}, meeting at y = 4.

pyq.q: The value of ∫_{−1}^{1} \f{(1 + √{|x| − x})e^{x} + (√{|x| − x})e^{−x}}{e^{x} + e^{−x}} dx is equal to
sol: The integrand = √{|x| − x} + \f{e^{x}}{e^{x} + e^{−x}}; the second part pairs with x → −x to give 1 on average → contributes 1.

pyq.q: The integral ∫_{0}^{π/4} \f{136 sin x}{3 sin x + 5 cos x}dx is equal to :
sol: Write 136 sin x = A(3 sin x + 5 cos x) + B(3 cos x − 5 sin x): A = 12, B = −20.

pyq.q: The value of ∫_{−π}^{π} \f{2y(1 + sin y)}{1 + cos^{2}y}dy is :
sol: The 2y part is odd and vanishes; 2y sin y/(1 + cos^{2}y) is even → 4∫_{0}^{π}\f{y sin y}{1 + cos^{2}y}dy.

pyq.q: ∫_{0}^{π/4} \f{cos^{2}x sin^{2}x}{(cos^{3}x + sin^{3}x)^{2}}dx is equal to ____.
sol: Divide by cos^{6}x: \f{tan^{2}x sec^{2}x}{(1 + tan^{3}x)^{2}}; put t = 1 + tan^{3}x.

pyq.q: The integral ∫_{0}^{π} \f{(x + 3) sin x}{1 + 3 cos^{2}x}dx is equal to
sol: ∫_{0}^{π}\f{sin x}{1 + 3 cos^{2}x} = \f{2}{√{3}} · \f{π}{3}; the x-part equals \f{π}{2} times it (x → π − x).

pyq.q: The integral ∫_{1/4}^{3/4} cos(2 cot^{−1}√{\f{1 − x}{1 + x}})dx is equal to:
sol: Put x = cos 2θ: √{\f{1 − x}{1 + x}} = tan θ, so cot^{−1}(tan θ) = \f{π}{2} − θ and the integrand is cos(π − 2θ) = −x.

pyq.q: The value of the integral ∫_{−1}^{2} log_{e}(x + √{x^{2} + 1})dx is :
sol: By parts: ∫ sinh^{−1}x dx = x sinh^{−1}x − √{x^{2} + 1}.
The two functions are inverses: y = √{2^{x} − 4} ⇔ x = log_{2}(y^{2} + 4).
So the two areas fill a rectangle: α = 4 × 2√{3} − 2 × 0 = 8√{3} → α^{2} = 192.

pyq.q: The value of ∫_{−π/6}^{π/6}(\f{π + 4x^{11}}{1 − sin(|x| + π/6)})dx is equal to:
sol: The x^{11} part is odd → 0. The rest is even: 2π∫_{0}^{π/6}\f{dx}{1 − sin(x + π/6)}.

pyq.q: 6∫_{0}^{π}|(sin 3x + sin 2x + sin x)|dx is equal to ____.
sol: sin 3x + sin 2x + sin x = sin 2x(2 cos x + 1): zero at \f{π}{2} and \f{2π}{3}.
Integrate piece by piece with the right signs: total \f{17}{6} → 17.
t → 6 − t swaps the two terms, so twice the integral = ∫_{2}^{4}1 dt = 2 → answer 1.

pyq.q: If I = ∫_{0}^{π/2}\f{sin^{3/2}x}{sin^{3/2}x + cos^{3/2}x}dx, then ∫_{0}^{2I}\f{x sin x cos x}{sin^{4}x + cos^{4}x}dx equals :
sol: I = \f{π}{4} (x → \f{π}{2} − x). So the upper limit is \f{π}{2}.
That is I(9, 13).

pyq.q: The value of the integral ∫_{0}^{∞}\f{log_{e}(x)}{x^{2} + 4}dx is:
sol: Put x = \f{4}{t}: the integral becomes ∫_{0}^{∞}\f{log 4 − log t}{t^{2} + 4}dt, so 2I = log 4 · ∫_{0}^{∞}\f{dt}{t^{2} + 4} = log 4 · \f{π}{4}.
I = \f{π log 2}{4}.

pyq.q: The value of the integral ∫_{π/6}^{π/3}(\f{4 − cosec^{2}x}{cos^{4}x})dx is:
sol: Put t = tan x: the integral becomes ∫(3t^{2} + 2 − \f{1}{t^{2}})dt from \f{1}{√{3}} to √{3}.

pyq.q: The value of the integral ∫_{−π/4}^{π/4}(\f{32 cos^{4}x}{1 + e^{sin x}})dx is:
sol: x → −x turns \f{1}{1 + e^{sin x}} into \f{e^{sin x}}{1 + e^{sin x}}: adding, 2I = ∫ 32 cos^{4}x dx.

pyq.q: The value of the integral ∫_{−1}^{1}(\f{x^{3} + |x| + 1}{x^{2} + 2|x| + 1})dx is equal to:
sol: x^{3} part is odd → 0. The rest is even: 2∫_{0}^{1}\f{x + 1}{(x + 1)^{2}}dx.
2 log 2.

pyq.q: Let [.] denote the greatest integer function. If ∫_{0}^{e^{3}}[\f{1}{e^{x−1}}]dx = α − log_{e}2, then α^{3} is equal to ____.
sol: [e^{1−x}] = 2 for x < 1 − log 2, 1 for x up to 1, 0 after.
Integral = 2(1 − log 2) + log 2 = 2 − log 2 → α = 2, α^{3} = 8.

pyq.q: Let [·] denote the greatest integer function. Then the value of ∫_{0}^{3}(\f{e^{x} + e^{−x}}{[x]!})dx is :
sol: On [0, 1) and [1, 2) divide by 1, on [2, 3) by 2. With F = e^{x} − e^{−x}:

pyq.q: Let [·] denote the greatest integer function. Then ∫_{−π/2}^{π/2}(\f{12(3 + [x])}{3 + [sin x] + [cos x]})dx is equal to :
sol: Split at −1, 0, 1: [x] and [sin x], [cos x] are constant on each piece.
Adding the pieces gives 11π + 2.

pyq.q: If 24∫_{0}^{π/4}(sin|4x − \f{π}{12}| + [2 sin x])dx = 2π + α, where [•] denotes the greatest integer function, then α is equal to ____.
Let ∫_{−2}^{2}(|sin x| + [x sin x])dx = 2(3 − cos 2) + β, where [·] is the greatest integer function. Then β sin(\f{β}{2}) equals:
sol: ∫_{−2}^{2}|sin x| = 2(1 − cos 2). [x sin x] = 1 where x sin x ≥ 1, i.e. a ≤ |x| ≤ 2 with a sin a = 1, and 0 elsewhere → contributes 2(2 − a).
Total 2(3 − cos 2) − 2a → β = −2a and β sin \f{β}{2} = 2a sin a = 2.

pyq.q: The value of ∫_{−π/2}^{π/2}(\f{1}{[x] + 4})dx, where [·] denotes the greatest integer function, is
If ∫cosec^{5}x dx = α cot x cosec x(cosec^{2}x + \f{3}{2}) + β log_{e}|tan \f{x}{2}| + C where α, β ∈ R and C is constant of integration then the value of 8(α + β) equals
sol: Reduction: ∫cosec^{n} = −\f{cot x cosec^{n−2}x}{n − 1} + \f{n − 2}{n − 1}∫cosec^{n−2}.

pyq.q: If ∫\f{1}{⁵√{(x − 1)^{4}(x + 3)^{6}}}dx = A(\f{αx − 1}{βx + 3})^{B} + C, where C is the constant of integration, then the value of α + β + 20AB is
sol: Put t = \f{x − 1}{x + 3}: dt = \f{4}{(x + 3)^{2}}dx and the root becomes (x + 3)^{2}t^{4/5}.

pyq.q: Let ∫\f{2 − tan x}{3 + tan x}dx = \f{1}{2}(αx + log_{e}|β sin x + γ cos x|) + C, where C is the constant of integration. Then α + \f{γ}{β} is equal to :
sol: Write 2 cos x − sin x = A(3 cos x + sin x) + B(cos x − 3 sin x): A = B = \f{1}{2}.
Integral = \f{1}{2}(x + log|sin x + 3 cos x|) → α = 1, β = 1, γ = 3 → 4.

pyq.q: Let f(x) = ∫(\f{16x + 24}{x^{2} + 2x − 15})dx. If f(4) = 14 log_{e}(3) and f(7) = log_{e}(2^{α} · 3^{β}), α, β ∈ N, then α + β is equal to :

If ∫\f{2x^{2} + 5x + 9}{√{x^{2} + x + 1}}dx = x√{x^{2} + x + 1} + α√{x^{2} + x + 1} + β log_{e}|x + \f{1}{2} + √{x^{2} + x + 1}| + C, where C is the constant of integration, then α + 2β is equal to ____.

words: End points of a definite integral
Odd or even shape that halves work
Partial ones split a rational function
